newsitem.title: NAMIBIA: Namibian stocks week - Ocean Diamonds leads trade.
newsitem.headline: Namibian stocks week - Ocean Diamonds leads trade.

text.p: Ocean Diamond Mining led trade on the Namibian Stock Exchange last week, maintaining its grip on the N$4.90-N$5.00 level after recent gains. It traded 124,100 shares on the NSE last week.

Gold Fields Namibia also enjoyed an active rise, climbing fast and closing the week at N$2.20 on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange after dealing in Namibia at N$2.10 from N$1.74 at the start of the week.
The biggest value traded was in Standard Bank Investment Corp, parent of the Namibian Bank, which traded 20,000 shares at a current and last price of N$43.00.

The total vaule traded during the week was N$6.6 million from N$7.8 million previously, with a volume of 312,194 shares from 2,185,500 shares. The NSE overall index dipped to 218.68 from 223.33. The NSE local index ended at 148.89 from 148.17.

The NSE said it would be closed on the public holidays, December 10, December 25-26 and January 1, 1997. It also said that it would be closed between Christmas and New Year, ie. on December 27, 30 and 31.
